requirements: Place a sticky horizontal four-cluster dock immediately below the hero: Bách Khoa / Sư Phạm; Kinh Tế DUE; Duy Tân / Hải Châu; Sơn Trà.
Filter in memory using explicit branch-to-cluster mappings, with immediate results immediately below the dock; target input-to-DOM p95 under 20ms.
Use verified branch addresses and offer applicability. Do not infer that all chain offers apply at every branch or label a venue as study-friendly without supporting details.
Add Lập kèo Zalo Pass to every F&B and cinema card while preserving its copy-code or terms CTA.
Provide 2-person and 3-person quick export controls on priced cards, calculating exact integer VND shares from an explicit group total.
Generate downloadable 1080x1440 PNG locally with venue, offer, price basis, group size, remainder distribution and JayT offer permalink.
If a price is per person, multiply by group size before splitting; if a combo is a group total, split that total. If price is missing or ambiguous, ask for the group total in a small inline form.

Payment QR requires an explicit, verified payee or user-supplied payee and visible review of recipient, amount and reference before export. Never invent an account or use JayT as the recipient by default. When unavailable, provide a separately labeled QR mở kèo leading to the JayT offer, not a QR thanh toán.
Sharing opens the device share sheet or downloads/copies locally; the user chooses recipients. Do not automatically message Zalo contacts.
Replace category icons with licensed or provider-supplied thumbnails matching each of the 30 actual SKU variants.
Verify product destination, seller identity, price timestamp and availability; replace invalid SKU records with real products in the same category.
Implement amber ĐÁY 90 NGÀY and emerald FREESHIP 0Đ badges, populated only when comparable 90-day history and applicable shipping conditions support them.
Missing evidence leaves the badge absent and displays a dated observed price; do not invent history or unconditional free shipping.
Activate provider-confirmed affiliate links when available, with commission disclosure; otherwise use verified direct product URLs. A manually appended partner_id alone does not prove attribution.

implementation_and_release: Edit canonical sources under 03_SOURCE_OF_TRUTH and synchronize deploy, deploy/public and the actual production payload; preserve unrelated working changes.
Snapshot the current deployment and payload before release. Preserve both themes and all existing offer records; add normalized applicability and price-basis metadata without dropping records.
Perform local interaction checks then deploy directly to the authorized canonical project. No new preview or additional general release decree is required.
Verify served hashes, endpoints and actual interactions after deployment. Repair or roll back a broken deployment using the recorded snapshot.
Prepare a Gemini review packet using the deployed mobile experience. Record its actual review separately; do not predeclare Gemini PASS.
